about: Every piece of shed equipment, trinket and yard kit Torque Shed has (equipment.gd MODELS, trinkets.gd MODELS, world_yard.gd fixtures), for the UE port's movable kit (Source/TorqueShedProto/Shed/TorqueFurniture). size: width, height, depth in metres (Torque Shed's footprint, +z the front). yard: outside kit. wall: hangs on a wall. ride: the bike rides on it (tagged Road). solid: the bike bumps into it (a contact box). pass: no contact box (ramps: ridden up and over via ride, never a wall the bike stops on). sold: ordered from the parts computer's Shed aisle (free in the UE port). The model is Data/Props' prop of the same id (/Game/Shed/Props/<id>/SM_<id>).

engine_stand.name: Engine stand
engine_stand.desc: A wheeled stand to strip and build an engine on. Get more than one and you can build engines while the bikes are being worked on.

engine_stand_folding.name: Folding engine stand
engine_stand_folding.desc: Folds flat against a wall when it's not in use. Takes up less floor than the full-size stand.

shelf_compact.name: Compact shelving
shelf_compact.desc: Narrow four-shelf unit that fits in the gaps.

shelf_standard.name: Shelving unit
shelf_standard.desc: Steel shelving for parts and boxed stock, with a label plate on top so everyone knows what goes where.

shelf_tall.name: Tall shelving
shelf_tall.desc: Five shelves up to the rafters. Same floor space as the standard unit, more shelf space.

shelf_wide.name: Wide shelving
shelf_wide.desc: Long boltless shelving for a whole bike's worth of parts.

shelf_racking.name: Heavy-duty racking
shelf_racking.desc: Warehouse pallet racking cut down for the shed. Holds engines and frames without bowing.

shelf_staff.name: Staff parts rack
shelf_staff.desc: The staff's own rack: the parts they've bought for a job and what's left over, a labelled board for each trade.

shelf_delivery.name: Delivery racking
shelf_delivery.desc: Racking in the delivery area: deliveries go on it when the floor's full.

washer_compact.name: Benchtop parts washer
washer_compact.desc: A small solvent tank on legs. One part at a time.

washer_standard.name: Parts washer
washer_standard.desc: The classic solvent sink with a pump and brush. Two parts at once.

washer_ultrasonic.name: Ultrasonic cleaner
washer_ultrasonic.desc: Shakes the grime off with sound. Small, quick and quiet.

washer_cabinet.name: Spray wash cabinet
washer_cabinet.desc: Hot jets in a closed cabinet. Three parts on the turntable.

washer_industrial.name: Industrial parts washer
washer_industrial.desc: A big heated tank that takes a full engine's worth of parts.

blaster_cabinet.name: Sandblasting cabinet
blaster_cabinet.desc: A glass-topped blast cabinet for engines. Put an engine in, hands in the gloves, and blast it back to bare metal.

blaster_pro.name: Industrial blast cabinet
blaster_pro.desc: A bigger cabinet with a bigger compressor: a wider, harder jet that strips an engine quicker. Easier to overdo, too.

repair_compact.name: Grinder stand
repair_compact.desc: A pedestal grinder and a small vice. One part at a time.

repair_standard.name: Repair bench
repair_standard.desc: Vice, grinder and welder on a steel bench. Two parts restored at once.

repair_blaster.name: Bead blast cabinet
repair_blaster.desc: Blasts rust off in a sealed cabinet. Small and fast.

repair_pro.name: Restoration station
repair_pro.desc: Welder, grinder, lathe and press. Three parts at once.

repair_workshop.name: Machine shop bench
repair_workshop.desc: Everything a machinist needs. Four parts at once, and quick.

bench_compact.name: Folding workbench
bench_compact.desc: A sturdy fold-up bench. Two places.

bench_mobile.name: Mobile tool bench
bench_mobile.desc: Tool chest on castors with a wooden top. Two places, and it goes where you need it.

bench_standard.name: Workbench
bench_standard.desc: A plain steel bench with a hardwood top. Three places.

bench_long.name: Long workbench
bench_long.desc: Room to lay out a whole top end. Four places.

bench_pro.name: Pro workstation
bench_pro.desc: Drawers, pegboard and a stainless top. Four places, and it looks the business.

trolley_parts.name: Parts trolley
trolley_parts.desc: A steel shop trolley on castors with a lipped deck. Load it up with parts and boxes and wheel them where they're needed.

trolley_flatbed.name: Flatbed trolley
trolley_flatbed.desc: A long, low platform truck for the heavy stuff: a whole delivery of boxes, an engine or a frame in one trip.

tyre_changer.name: Tyre changer
tyre_changer.desc: A pedestal tyre machine with a clamping turntable, a bead breaker and a mount head. Put a wheel on it to change its tyre.

poster_tt.name: Island TT 1967 poster
poster_tt.desc: Faded race poster from the golden age of road racing.

poster_cafe.name: Café racer club poster
poster_cafe.desc: Black and gold club poster. Ton-up or bust.

poster_mx.name: Motocross nationals poster
poster_mx.desc: Loud orange flyer for a muddy Sunday.

poster_oil.name: Gold Seal motor oil sign
poster_oil.desc: Old enamel-look advert for an oil nobody makes any more.

poster_salt.name: Salt flats speed record poster
poster_salt.desc: Streamliners on the salt, chasing the record.

poster_board.name: Whiteboard poster
poster_board.desc: The crew's own whiteboard drawing, printed and framed.

seat_stool.name: Shop stool
seat_stool.desc: Swivel stool with a red vinyl top.

seat_creeper.name: Creeper seat
seat_creeper.desc: Low roller seat with a tray underneath, for working on wheels and brakes.

seat_chair.name: Folding chair
seat_chair.desc: Canvas camp chair. For watching someone else do the work.

seat_bench.name: Garage bench seat
seat_bench.desc: Wooden slat bench for the whole crew.

seat_sofa.name: Old leather sofa
seat_sofa.desc: Saggy, cracked and the comfiest thing in the shed.

tv_120.name: 120" TV
tv_120.desc: As big as the screens over the bays. Live riding, the crew board, XP goals and more: right mouse changes the channel.

tv_128.name: 128" TV
tv_128.desc: Proper cinema size. Watch the crew ride from across the shed.

tv_136.name: 136" TV
tv_136.desc: A whole wall of screen, as big as the crew board. Needs a clear stretch of wall.

ramp_small.name: Small wooden ramp
ramp_small.desc: A low plywood ramp. Hop a foot or two in the air.

ramp_kicker.name: Steep kicker ramp
ramp_kicker.desc: Short and steep, curved all the way up to a lip of over 35 degrees. It throws you up more than along.

ramp_medium.name: Medium jump ramp
ramp_medium.desc: Proper air. Steady throttle up the face and keep your weight central.

ramp_large.name: Large jump ramp
ramp_large.desc: Steel-framed launch ramp. Bring speed, and a landing.

ramp_xl.name: Big launch ramp
ramp_xl.desc: A stunt-show ramp on a braced steel frame. Clears a car or a bus with the big landing ramp beyond.

ramp_huge.name: Huge launch ramp
ramp_huge.desc: Bus height at the lip. Line it up with the row of buses and the huge landing ramp, and come in fast.

ramp_landing.name: Landing ramp
ramp_landing.desc: Long gentle slope to land on. Turn it to face a jump ramp, a bike's length or three away.

landing_xl.name: Big landing ramp
landing_xl.desc: A flat top to clear and a long steel slope down. Face it to the big launch ramp.

landing_huge.name: Huge landing ramp
landing_huge.desc: Its flat top is bus height: butt it up against the far side of the buses and come down the long slope.

tabletop.name: Dirt tabletop
tabletop.desc: Up, across the flat top, and down the far side. Clear the top for the big landing.

barrels.name: Row of oil drums
barrels.desc: Three drums on their sides. The classic stunt-show jump.

log.name: Log
log.desc: Trials practice: wheelie the front over and let the back follow.

tyre_stack.name: Tyre stack
tyre_stack.desc: Old car tyres piled up. A marker you can lean on, or a target to miss.

hay_bales.name: Hay bales
hay_bales.desc: Two bales side by side. Soft-ish.

car_wreck.name: Old car
car_wreck.desc: A rusty saloon with no engine. Jump it, if you dare.

bus.name: Old bus
bus.desc: A retired single-decker, parked broadside on. Solid to the roof, so you can land on it too.

bus_row.name: Row of old buses
bus_row.desc: Five old buses parked side by side, stunt-show style: the huge launch ramp one side, the huge landing ramp the other.

wall_concrete.name: Concrete barrier
wall_concrete.desc: Road-works barrier. Builds a track edge that stays put.

wall_brick.name: Brick wall section
wall_brick.desc: A short run of brick wall on a frame.

fence_wood.name: Wooden fence panel
fence_wood.desc: Post and rail fence for marking out a paddock.

fence_mesh.name: Mesh fence panel
fence_mesh.desc: Site fencing on concrete feet. Keeps spectators back.

cone.name: Traffic cone
cone.desc: Orange cone for slaloms and braking markers. Ride through it, it won't hurt.

flag_red.name: Red course flag
flag_red.desc: A flag on a pole to mark a turn.

flag_blue.name: Blue course flag
flag_blue.desc: A flag on a pole to mark the other side of a gate.

flag_chequered.name: Chequered flag
flag_chequered.desc: Start, finish, or just showing off.

trinket_bobblehead.name: Bobblehead racer
trinket_bobblehead.desc: A little racer with a big nodding helmet. Put it on the bench and it nods along while you work.

trinket_gnome.name: Biker gnome
trinket_gnome.desc: A garden gnome in a leather jacket and an open-face lid. Guards the door.

trinket_plant.name: Potted plant
trinket_plant.desc: A big leafy plant in a terracotta pot. Somebody has to water it.

trinket_photo.name: Framed photo
trinket_photo.desc: A framed photo of a bike on a mountain road at sunset. Hangs on a wall.

trinket_lava.name: Lava lamp
trinket_lava.desc: Orange goo rising and falling in a glowing lamp. Very seventies.

trinket_clock.name: Workshop wall clock
trinket_clock.desc: A big station clock that keeps the shed's time, hour, minute and second hands and all. Hangs on a wall.

trinket_clock_digital.name: Digital wall clock
trinket_clock_digital.desc: A red LED wall clock showing the shed's time, the colon blinking. Hangs on a wall.

trinket_clock_desk.name: Digital desk clock
trinket_clock_desk.desc: A little alarm clock with a green display showing the shed's time. Sits on a bench.

trinket_trophy.name: Gold race trophy
trinket_trophy.desc: A gold cup on a wooden plinth. Nobody remembers what it was for.

trinket_rug.name: Chequered flag rug
trinket_rug.desc: A chequered flag rug for the floor. Lie on it to work under a bike.

trinket_radio.name: Toolbox radio
trinket_radio.desc: A yellow site radio in a roll cage, built to be dropped off a scaffold.

trinket_bike_model.name: Mini bike model
trinket_bike_model.desc: A die-cast model of a café racer on a little display stand.

trinket_neon.name: Neon shed sign
trinket_neon.desc: A pink neon sign that says TORQUE SHED. Glows in the dark. Hangs on a wall.

trinket_adventure_photo.name: Adventure photo
trinket_adventure_photo.desc: The crew at the end of an adventure ride, framed. Hangs on a wall.
